blocks.html: Find a drone on the network, open its feed, and read its altitude, battery and link without leaving ATAK.

slides.title: Open the drone list
slides.html:
The UAS Tool Home Screen lists every drone on the network under Network UAS.

  • Drones in UAS Observer mode have a black background; an Operator Connected drone sits on top with a blue background.
  • Each entry shows signal strength and battery at a glance.

slides.title: Select a platform
slides.html:
Tap a drone to select it and open its ribbon.

  • The ribbon exposes Platform Settings, Platform Health, Platform Information and Pan To.
  • Only one drone can be selected at a time.

slides.title: Open the UAS Display
slides.html:
Tap the Play button to open the UAS Full Motion Video (FMV) display.

  • The video fills the screen with the Quick Flight Toolbar on top, the Instrument Panel (heading, horizon, GPS fix) on the right and the Lower Toolbar along the bottom.

slides.title: Read the status overlay
slides.html: The sUAS Metadata in the upper-left gives you the live numbers: remaining battery, connection strength, range and bearing from your position, and altitude (AGL). Check these before and during every flight.
